diagnosis.root_cause: Primary cache node redis-01 became unresponsive and automatic failover failed due to a split-brain guard, causing cache availability to drop and resulting in traffic bypass to the databases with a spike in connection utilization.
evidence: session-store / cache_availability dropped from ~1.0 to ~0.0 around 07:41-07:42
users-db / db_connection_utilization spiked from 40% to nearly 100% starting at 07:43
session-store log line at 07:40:00Z: ERROR primary node redis-01 unresponsive; automatic failover to redis-02 did not complete (split-brain guard)
diagnosis.recommended_fix: Manually resolve the split-brain condition and restore the primary cache node redis-01 or force the failover to redis-02. Follow up by investigating the split-brain guard failure mechanism to prevent automatic failover blocks in the future.
